event_chain.summary: Employee and student data exfiltrated from H drive
Ransomware disrupts web, portal, internet, phones; storage erased

summary: On June 17, 2026 Mount Royal University in Calgary discovered a ransomware attack that disrupted internal systems, online services including its website and MyMRU portal, campus internet and phones. Attackers exfiltrated and deleted employee and student personal information from folders on the university's H drive and erased a second departmental storage system. The CMD Organization group listed the university on its leak site, claimed more than 10 TB of data and demanded about $1.9 million in cryptocurrency. MRU reported the attack to police and the Alberta privacy commissioner and offered two years of credit monitoring to current and recent employees.
